limitations_and_boundaries: Human and murine bile acids have substantially different signaling properties.
Less abundant and/or characterized bile acid metabolites may hamper translational conclusions.
Differences in microbiota may explain individual responses to bile acid-derived drugs.
It is not known whether FXR modulation in humans leads to an altered microbiota.
The interaction between FXR and specific macronutrients warrants further investigation.
It remains to be demonstrated how intestinal FXR signaling is modulated in humans after bariatric surgery.

research_questions.statement: How does the gut microbiota modulate bile acid signaling via FXR and TGR5, and what is the impact on host metabolism?
